acceptanceCriteria: A relative --root, including the default, either resolves to its absolute path or is refused with a root-specific reason.
A test covers the relative-root case.
body: Found in the V1-1677 spike (2026-10-18, docs/build-log/2026-10-18-cce-spike-v1-1677.md), corvint-test built from claude/cce-env-1681 at 4358358ee. Reproduction: in a Git checkout, `corvint-test e2e catalog --root . --manifest corvint/appmap.json --rev <full commit sha> --out /tmp/x.json`. Expected: the relative root resolves to the working directory, or is refused as a root error. Actual: e2e-map-unavailable: evaluated revision is not a commit, which points at the revision. The same command with --root "$PWD" succeeds. The flag default is "." (cmd/corvint-test/main.go:52), so the default itself fails this way.
